title: Slimline probe + telemetry gate for low-overhead request instrumentation
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Introduce a lightweight instrumentation probe ("slimline-probe") and a runtime-configurable telemetry gate designed for short-lived SDKs, edge functions, and high-concurrency frontends. The goal is to attach minimal tracing metadata (request id, sample hint, compact fingerprint) with microsecond-level overhead and a small header footprint, while allowing the control plane to enable richer hooks without redeploying customers. This ticket spans SDK middleware changes, HTTP/gRPC header compacting, sampling hint handshake, and a staged rollout via remote config.
acceptance_criteria: Node/Python/Go SDKs ship a slimline-probe integration that adds <=120ns median overhead in benchmark harness
Compact header format documented and backward-compatible with existing propagation (older SDKs ignore unknown header safely)
Remote telemetry gate can be toggled per org via console and changes propagate within 60s to SDKs using config poll or push
Canary rollout (5% traffic) completes with no increase in dropped spans and error rate within 0.5% of baseline
E2E tests covering context reconstruction for truncated headers and multi-hop edge->origin flows added to CI
implementation_steps: Design compact header: 3-field binary-ish base64 with version byte, request id (64-bit), sample hint (2 bits). Write spec doc (confluence).
Add slimline-probe middleware to Node SDK (express/fastify), Python (ASGI/Werkzeug), Go (net/http) with opt-in guard and config polling hook.
Implement telemetry gate config in control plane (console + API) and a lightweight push path for active SDKs.
Create a feature flagging rule and canary pipeline: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with rollback thresholds.
Benchmarks: microbench harness and customer-like scenario (latency tail and p50/p95), compare with current SDK instrumentation.
Add CI fuzz tests for truncated/extra header bytes and multi-hop propagation scenarios.
Docs: SDK migration notes, header spec, and troubleshooting runbook for ops.
Ship SDK packages and update runtime-1.28 release notes with guidance on enabling the telemetry gate.
comments: 2026-02-20: Initial design review meeting — agreed on 3-field compact header and versioning to allow future enrichment.
2026-02-25: Prototype Node middleware implemented; measured ~85ns median overhead in local harness (baseline: 30ns). Need micro-optimizations in base64 encode path.
2026-03-02: UX review — console needs an org-level toggle and a per-service override. PM ok with org default off, opt-in per service.
2026-03-06: Security flagged requirement for header HMAC option for high-security tenants — added follow-up task (linked in dependencies).
2026-03-10: PR #8432 opened for Node SDK; reviewer feedback: move sampling hint encode to hot path and reduce heap allocations.
2026-03-11: Loadbench with canary flow on staging: p50 unchanged, p95 +0.2ms for instrumented path; no increase in span drop rate.
2026-03-12: Decided to ship slimline-probe as opt-in default off and enable gate via console; rollout automation ready.
Follow-ups: integrate HMAC header option, add Go zero-allocation path, and update language SDKs' docs with migration checklist.
